releaseNotes: UPDATE YOUR OLD CLONES WITHOUT RE-CLONING — clones made before the last update can't show the in-clone Update button (it has to be installed first, chicken-and-egg). This version fixes that: open Clone by Ophelia and a big 'Ophelia engine update' banner appears at the top of your clone list with an 'Update all' button. One tap re-patches every old clone in place — same name, same icon, same logins, same data, nothing to set up again.

Every clone card now also gets its own full-width 'Update clone' button whenever there is something to update (old engine OR a newer Discord), with the reason written right under it — no more hunting for a tiny refresh icon.
Updating a clone keeps EVERYTHING: saved switcher accounts, Discord logins, settings, chats cache. It's the same app, just with the new engine inside.
After this one update pass, future fixes really are one tap from INSIDE the clone: tap your profile tab → 'Update this clone' under Switch Accounts (above Quests).
Install is quiet on Android 12+ (no repeated confirm dialogs) when updating several clones at once.
switcherReleaseNotes: No switcher dex change this round — the embedded engine stays v4 (the in-panel Switch Accounts row above Quests + the in-clone Update button). This update is the cloner-side rescue path that finally DELIVERS v4 to clones made before it existed.
